notes: Five co-transmitters on one level (semicolon list), the first being the compiler's father, bare «أبي»: relation.
«قالوا» begins the next level (حدثنا محمد بن يحيى العطار). «الحسين مولى أبي عبد الله» is kept as one surface: the patron phrase is part of the name as written.

The Imam named in Yazid's words («لقينا أبا عبداللّه») is the last link (imam_in_text). Within his account, Musa's words, the Prophet's dream and a nested «فقال لي» are speakers inside one long first-person report: rule 11, flagged.
